description: This file defines classes and methods for managing test fixtures in Playwright, including setup, teardown, and dependency resolution of fixtures within a testing environment.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Represents a test fixture with setup and teardown logic, dependencies, and usage tracking.

classes.name: FixtureRunner
classes.description: Manages fixture instances, their setup and teardown, and parameter resolution for test functions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the fixture, executing its setup function if applicable.

methods.name: _setupInternal
methods.description: Performs internal setup logic, resolving dependencies and invoking the fixture function.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Performs fixture teardown, including cleanup and dependency management.

methods.name: _teardownInternal
methods.description: Handles internal teardown logic, resolving fixture cleanup promises.

methods.name: _collectFixturesInTeardownOrder
methods.description: Recursively collects fixtures in the order needed for teardown based on dependencies.

methods.name: setPool
methods.description: Assigns a fixture pool to the runner, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: _collectFixturesInSetupOrder
methods.description: Recursively collects fixtures in the order needed for setup based on dependencies.

methods.name: teardownScope
methods.description: Tears down all fixtures within a specified scope ('test' or 'worker').

methods.name: resolveParametersForFunction
methods.description: Resolves fixture parameters required for a test function.

methods.name: resolveParametersAndRunFunction
methods.description: Resolves fixture parameters and executes the test function.

methods.name: _setupFixtureForRegistration
methods.description: Sets up a fixture based on its registration details.

methods.name: dependsOnWorkerFixturesOnly
methods.description: Checks if a function depends only on worker-scoped fixtures.
